newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Lojas Arapua set to buy Casa Centro.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Lojas Arapua set to buy Casa Centro.

text.p: Brazilian retail chain Lojas Arapua SA said it has signed a letter of intent to buy competitor Casa Centro pending the approval of Casa Centro's creditors.
Lojas said in a statement that the purchase of Casa Centro would also be subject to the approval of an accounting report to determine Casa Centro's value and general financial health.
Casa Centro, one of Brazil's largest retail chains, has a network of 22 stores. The store reported monthly revenue of 30 million reais in May of this year.

In May 1995, Casa Centro filed for debt relief under a section of bankruptcy law similar to Chapter 11 in the United States as it was unable to meet payments on a 300 million real debt with suppliers and creditor banks.
